source: Semrush most visited websites in the world, ranks 1-100 for May 2026: 66 entries kept, plus 6 entries carried over from the earlier Brazil-localized set, after a maintainer curation pass over the filtered result
notes: Global ranking on generic TLDs only. Excluded: adult and gambling sites; every country-edition domain (.br, .de, .it, .co.uk, .pt, .co.jp, .in, .vn, .ru, .su), since a national storefront or edition measures one country rather than the global web -- a brand on a generic TLD such as globo.com is kept, so the rule is about the extension, not the company; region-specific Asian services (naver, rakuten, note); volatile piracy aggregators; and domains owned by any resolver dnsbench benchmarks (Google, Cloudflare, Cisco/OpenDNS, Mullvad, NextDNS, AdGuard, Quad9, Control D) to avoid a home-domain advantage. Generic-in-practice TLDs (.ai, .io, .net, .org, .tv, .us) are kept because those domains are the service's global home, not a national edition. A maintainer pass then trimmed the filtered result further, dropping redundant corporate properties, redirect-only short-link domains, and entries whose traffic was driven by a single event.
